Specify a location for the Remotion config file.

## CLI flag

Use `--config` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                             | Flag               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                               | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                               | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                                 | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)                   | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle)                               | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)                         | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)                 | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)                   | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda compositions`](/docs/lambda/cli/compositions)     | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda sites create`](/docs/lambda/cli/sites/create)     | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)             | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)               | `--config <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun sites create`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/sites/create) | `--config <value>` |
